result.rationale: In refreshOAuthTokens, the sync path does `const response = await fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...); return response;` — a raw fetch Response. adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `hubspotRefreshToken` is typed as `HubspotToken` but is assigned from `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`. In the sync-enabled branch, `refreshOAuthTokens` performs a `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` and returns the `Response` object (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`), not a token payload. This will break at runtime when later code treats the value as `HubspotToken` (the type annotation masks the mismatch).
